newsitem.title: USA: Peco boosts power at 1,055 MW Pa. nuke - NRC.
newsitem.headline: Peco boosts power at 1,055 MW Pa. nuke - NRC.

text.p: PECO Energy Co was increasing power at its 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear unit after a problem in a recirculation pump halted a restart that began last weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Thursday.
The Pottsdam, Pa., nuclear unit, which was operating at 37 percent power, was manually shut when the pump problem was discovered Tuesday, NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Limerick 2 was last taken off line December 18 to repair a leaking seal detected in the condenser.
The nearby 1,055 MW Limerick unit 1 was running at full output, NRC said.
